reason: The README describes an installable plugin that adds OpenAI Codex device-login authentication, OAuth credential storage, and an authentication controller for DSH pi-ai routes.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH pi-ai 路由提供 OpenAI Codex 设备登录、OAuth 凭据存储和认证控制器。
summaries.en: Adds OpenAI Codex device-login authentication, OAuth credential storage, and an authentication controller for DSH pi-ai routes.

capabilities: stores OAuth credentials in a local file
registers an authentication controller for the openai-codex provider
performs OAuth requests from the DSH Node process
